title: The Quiet Readings at Halvard Station
summary: Temperature records from the remote Halvard Island research station look unusually smooth for three nights in March, just before a funding review. The edits were made under the technician's account, but she says she was not on the island. Who changed the data, and why?

key_facts.text: Edits were made at 02:10 on 14 March under Bea Lund's account
The boat manifest shows Lund left the island on 13 March
Halden requested a password reset of Lund's account on 12 March
Satellite data shows a storm spike that the station record no longer has
Funding renewal depended on showing a stable instrument record
Halden's claim that only he and Lund knew the password is contradicted by the reset

traps.explanation: The boat manifest shows Lund was not on the island at 02:10 on 14 March.
Satellite comparison shows the sensor was right; the stored file was edited.
